info:
Russian has one past form of "to be": быть → был/была/были. The verb agrees with gender and number. In the present tense, "to be" is usually omitted (Я врач = I am a doctor). Past verbs also distinguish perfective (completed action) and imperfective (ongoing/repeated action).

Russian frequently replaces "was" with more specific verbs like дружить (be friends), отвечать (be in charge), болеть (be sick), отдыхать (be on vacation), думать (be thinking), or ждать (be waiting).

answer: Это была тёмная и дождливая ночь.
